name: Charles Dickens
hook: Dickens is the Victorian novelist Jeopardy keeps returning to — six titles cover most clues.

facts.label: the Victorian novelist
facts.statement: Queen Victoria called his death in 1870 "a very great loss"; his closest friend John Forster was portrayed as Mr. Podsnap in Our Mutual Friend.

facts.label: A Christmas Carol
facts.statement: A Christmas Carol is divided into staves, not chapters; Stave IV is "The Last of the Spirits", and Tiny Tim was nearly named Little Fred.

facts.label: Oliver Twist
facts.statement: Oliver Twist is subtitled "The Parish Boy's Progress"; Mr. Bumble takes the orphan to the workhouse, and the 1968 musical Oliver! won Best Picture.

facts.label: David Copperfield
facts.statement: David Copperfield is the Dickens tale with the villain Uriah Heep, who had a heap of hate for the title character.

facts.label: A Tale of Two Cities
facts.statement: A Tale of Two Cities begins in 1775 and ends at the guillotine; Charles Darnay is nephew of the wicked Marquis de St. Evremonde.

facts.label: Great Expectations
facts.statement: Great Expectations opens with Philip Pirrip — Pip — and his family name; David Lean filmed it in 1946.

facts.label: Bleak House
facts.statement: Bleak House, published from 1852, features the Jarndyce case, Inspector Bucket and the solicitor Tulkinghorn.
